services_shape: class: a spot in a set class time with a set number of places and a waitlist; each person booked is checked in on their own. Private sessions book one teacher, at the studio, a home or an office
questions_before_times: new to the studio, or been before (sets any intro price and the waiver)
the class or style, and heated or not
for kids yoga: the child's age
for a private session: the goals, and at the studio, a home or an office
for an office class or team event: how many people
safety_stop: someone unwell right now: chest pain, fainting, trouble breathing, confusion after heat
first_steps: Waiver (with the heat notice for heated classes)
Intake for a private session or yoga therapy
license: from the state form: teaching yoga usually needs no state license; massage needs one where the state's rules require it; some places register fitness studios or health clubs
staff_skills: heated, flow, yin, kids, prenatal, therapy; only teachers cleared for kids classes teach them
messages_never: health answers, injuries, pregnancy and incident notes never go in a text or through the AI: only the secure page and the student's record
demo_note: Demo data for testing only. [G] = prefilled from the business's Google listing at sign-up; the owner checks each field.
